description: A progression describing how deeply AI is integrated into human judgment, workflows, teams, and institutions.

stages.name: Aware
stages.shortDescription: Recognize where AI may affect work and learning.
stages.longDescription: People and leaders understand the opportunity, limitations, risks, and responsibilities associated with AI.
stages.objective: Build shared understanding and identify a meaningful starting point.
risks: Treating AI as either magic or a threat
Starting with tools before defining the problem
stages.milestone: A clear opportunity and responsible use question are identified.
exitCriteria: Can explain the intended human outcome
Can identify basic risks and review needs
Has selected a practical next experiment

stages.name: Exploring
stages.shortDescription: Test how AI can support a real task.
stages.longDescription: People try AI on bounded tasks, compare results, and begin developing judgment about when it helps or distracts.
stages.objective: Find useful applications while keeping human judgment visible.
risks: Using sensitive information without clear safeguards
stages.milestone: One repeatable task has a clear, useful AI-supported pattern.
exitCriteria: Can repeat the task with a consistent review step

stages.name: Experimenting
stages.shortDescription: Run deliberate experiments with AI-supported workflows.
stages.longDescription: People and teams compare approaches, document results, and learn which AI-supported practices improve the work.
stages.objective: Turn isolated trials into evidence about a better way to work.
stages.milestone: An experiment produces evidence for a repeatable workflow decision.
exitCriteria: Can explain what should be adopted or changed

stages.name: Integrating
stages.shortDescription: Make reliable AI practices part of normal work.
stages.longDescription: AI-supported workflows are incorporated into regular practice with clear roles, controls, handoffs, and review expectations.
stages.objective: Create dependable workflows that improve outcomes over time.
stages.milestone: AI-supported work operates reliably within an established workflow.

stages.name: Leading
stages.shortDescription: Guide others in responsible AI-supported work.
stages.longDescription: Leaders shape shared standards, coach people, manage risk, and connect AI-supported practice to team or institutional outcomes.
stages.objective: Make reliable AI capability a shared leadership practice.
stages.milestone: People can use shared standards to make sound AI-supported decisions.

stages.name: Augmenting
stages.shortDescription: Expand human capability through mature AI partnership.
stages.longDescription: AI is embedded in a continuously improving operating model that expands human capability while preserving agency, judgment, and accountability.
stages.objective: Sustain responsible improvement as people, workflows, and technology change.
stages.milestone: AI-supported capability improves continuously at the appropriate level of scale.
exitCriteria: The operating model adapts to change
